runcmd.description: Command to (re)submit the jobscript. Default is `sbatch`. For local testing replace with an empty string do run the jobscript directly.

dryrun.title: dryrun
dryrun.description: Don't run the actual simulations, just print the tasks

just_sample.title: just sample
just_sample.description: Don't execute the recipes returned by the chosen reaction, just get the rates (and choose one). KIMMDY will exit after reactions have been queried for the first time in the sequence.

parameterize_at_setup.title: parameterize_at_setup
parameterize_at_setup.description: parameterize the topology during the setup task

cwd.title: cwd
cwd.description: Working directory. Default is current working directory

name.title: name
name.description: Used for output folder if `out` is not specified

file.description: Logfile name (will result in a path relative to `out`)

max_tasks.title: max_tasks
max_tasks.description: Maximum number of tasks to run. This is useful when a task in the sequence can dymanically add more tasks. 0 means no limit.

max_hours.title: max_hours
max_hours.description: Stop KIMMDY after max_hours hours. Set this lower than the limit of your HPC cluster for use with a re-submit jobscript. 0 Means no limit.

kmc_seed.title: kmc_seed
kmc_seed.description: Seed for the KMC random number generator. Each decide task draws from its own stream built from (kmc_seed, task number), so cycles get different random numbers while a run, and a restart that redoes a task, stays reproducible. If unset, an unseeded generator is used and the picked recipe differs between runs.

reaction_frame_whole_molecules.title: reaction_frame_whole_molecules
reaction_frame_whole_molecules.description: Extract the coordinates at the reaction time against the MD run's TPR with `-pbc mol -ur compact`, so no molecule is split across the box. Default: False

kmc.title: kmc
kmc.description: KMC algorithm overwrite. Should be set by the reactions, but can be changed here. Not all reactions may support all algorithms.

multi_kmc.title: multi_kmc
multi_kmc.description: Number of reactions to be executed in one step by a `multi` variant of a KMC algorithm.

tau_scale.title: tau_scale
tau_scale.description: Scaling parameter for tau in the extrande kmc algorithm.

topology.title: topology
topology.description: Settings for handling the topology file.

reactive.title: reactive
reactive.description: Specify what moleculetypes will be part of the Reactive moleculetype. By default, solvent and ions are excluded.

include.description: Explicitly include a moleculetype or list of moleculetypes as a space-separated string.

exclude.description: Explicitly exclude a moleculetype or a list as a space-separated string. For example the lipid moleculetype in a bilayer simulation e.g. `DPPC POPC'`

nrexcl.description: Explictly set the nrexcl value for the Reactive moleculetype. By default the value is taken from the first found reactive moleculetype.

product_template_sources.title: Product template sources
product_template_sources.description: Sources used to restore hydrogenated product atom identities, atom types, masses, and charges. Exact ITP templates are attempted before legacy RTP handling.

product_template_itp_glob.title: Product template ITP glob
product_template_itp_glob.description: Glob used to discover molecule ITP files in the configured force-field directory.

product_template_transitions.title: Product template transitions
product_template_transitions.description: Explicit case-sensitive precursor-to-product moleculetype mappings that permit atom-type changes after an exact precursor ITP match.

edissoc.title: edissoc
edissoc.description: File with additional dissociation energy terms. This is used for the homolysis and hydrolysis reactions.

grompp_prefix.title: grompp_prefix
grompp_prefix.description: Prefix command for grompp execution on non MPI compiled clusters, e.g., 'srun --ntasks=1'.

mdrun_prefix.title: mdrun_prefix
mdrun_prefix.description: Prefix command for mdrun execution on non MPI compiled clusters, e.g., 'srun --ntasks=1'.

gmx_mdrun_flags.title: gmx_mdrun_flags
gmx_mdrun_flags.description: Flags passed to gmx mdrun. Default `-maxh 24 -dlb yes`

ff.title: ff
ff.description: Force field directory (looks for .ff in cwd if not set)

residuetypes.title: residuetypes
residuetypes.description: GROMACS rtp file that contains residuetypes. Looks for `aminoacids.rtp` it not set. KIMMDY will first look in the current working directory and then relative to the forecfield directory.

radicals.title: radicals
radicals.description: space-separated string of radical atom ids, can be empty

tpr.title: tpr
tpr.description: .tpr file of a finished simulation for starting directly with a reaction

trr.title: trr
trr.description: .trr file of a finished simulation for starting directly with a reaction

xtc.title: xtc
xtc.description: .xtc file of a finished simulation for starting directly with a reaction

mdp.title: mdp
mdp.description: .mdp file of a finished simulation for starting directly with a reaction

edr.title: edr
edr.description: This is deprecated and no longer required.

restart.title: restart
restart.description: Restart or continue from a previous run (in config.out) instead of starting from scratch

mds.title: mds
mds.description: Settings for MD steps, e.g. mdp files, plumed files, etc.

mdp.description: MDP file for the MD step

use_plumed.description: Whether plumed should be used for this run or not

changer.title: changer
changer.description: Settings for applying a reaction recipe

coordinates.title: coordinates
coordinates.description: Settings related to coordinate/geometry changes when applying a recipe

md.description: MD step from the 'mds' section that is used for relaxation MDs

slow_growth_pairs.description: This is deprecated. Specify in `config.changer.coordinates.slow_growth` instead.

slow_growth.description: Whether the chosen MD step is a slow growth/free-energy simulation to relax after applying a reaction recipe. `true` and `yes` are equivalent to `full` for backwards compatibility. `morse_only` disables using pairs to transition non-bonded interactions as well and only uses morse bonds to emulate simple non-bonded interactions. The empty string means no slow growth.

retype_transferred_h.description: Retype transferred HW/HO hydrogen atoms as a force-field LJ-bearing hydrogen type (H1 in Amber) in state B of the temporary relaxation topology. State A keeps the original type, so the H's Lennard-Jones parameters grow in linearly with lambda. The final reaction topology is unchanged.

harmonic_acceptor_h_relax_term.description: In the relaxation topology only, add a harmonic helper bond (function type 6, no exclusions) between the transferred hydrogen and its acceptor. Its length is the new bond's equilibrium length and its force constant grows linearly from 0 at lambda 0 to harmonic_acceptor_h_relax_k at lambda 1, pulling the H onto the acceptor while the old bond fades. The final reaction topology is unchanged.

harmonic_acceptor_h_relax_k.description: Force constant at lambda 1 of the harmonic acceptor-H relax helper bond, in kJ mol^-1 nm^-2 (an Amber O-H bond is 462,750).

parallel_dihedral_merge.description: Merge slow-growth dihedrals in parallel while applying results deterministically.

parallel_dihedral_workers.description: Number of worker processes for parallel_dihedral_merge; when omitted, KIMMDY_DIHEDRAL_WORKERS is used (otherwise one).

topology.title: topology
topology.description: Settings for parameter changes in the topology file

break_plumed.description: Whether to remove bonds from the plumed.dat input file when applying a reaction recipe that breaks a bond. Unless needed for performance optimization, this can be left at `false`, because the homolysis plugin in kimmdy-reactions also cheeckts to not break non-existing bonds by default (which can be turned off).

parameterization.description: Parameterization scheme that is used on the topology file after changes to it

parameterization_kwargs.description: Keyword argument container for the selected parameterization scheme

improper_neighbors_by_bonding.title: Improper neighbours by bonding
improper_neighbors_by_bonding.description: Find the previous and next residue for residue-template impropers (-C, +N) through the backbone C-N bond instead of by atom number. Without it, a hydrogen that moved into a residue (and keeps its distant atom number) makes the rebuilt impropers point into an unrelated residue. Default: True

keep_all_improper_periodicities.title: Keep all improper periodicities
keep_all_improper_periodicities.description: Keep every periodic term a residue template lists for one atom quadruple (for example the five-term a99SB-disp backbone psi correction) when impropers are rebuilt after a reaction. Without it, only the last listed term is kept. Default: True

combine_same_periodicity_dihedrals.title: Combine same-periodicity dihedrals
combine_same_periodicity_dihedrals.description: Merge funct-4 terms that share atoms and periodicity (a99SB-disp lists two periodicity-1 terms on every backbone psi) into one equivalent term, in topologies and residue templates. Forces are unchanged and the energy shifts by a constant. Without it, only the last such term is kept. Default: True

handle_duplicate_topology_lines.title: Handle duplicate topology lines
handle_duplicate_topology_lines.description: When reading a topology, merge repeated proper dihedral lines (function 1 or 9) that share atoms and periodicity and carry explicit numbers into one equivalent term, and stop with an error on any other repeated line (bonds, angles, pairs, dihedrals without numbers, impropers when combine_same_periodicity_dihedrals is off). KIMMDY keeps one term per atom set, while GROMACS applies every line, so silently keeping only the last line would change the physics. Default: True

conserve_transferred_h_charge.title: Conserve transferred-H charge
conserve_transferred_h_charge.description: After a hydrogen transfer, keep the hydrogen's pre-transfer partial charge and subtract it from the acceptor atom, instead of assigning residue-template charges to both. Templates still provide the hydrogen's name and atom type and the rebuilt impropers. The net charge then never changes, including at chain-terminal residues. Default: True

sequence.title: sequence
sequence.description: List of tasks. Each task can be a string (the name of the task) or an object with the task name and a multiplicity `mult: <int>`

save_recipes.title: save_recipes
save_recipes.description: Save recipes as csv during the reactions step
